capabilities: Draw freehand ink on canvas files with pen, eraser, select and text tools
Embed canvases inside canvas cards with breadcrumb navigation
List under each note the canvases it appears on and its connections there
Style text cards with shapes, colours and theme fonts
Navigate large canvases with a zoom bar and minimap
extras: Part of the ICOR for Life suite; author labels it beta and asks users to open issues; requires Obsidian's core Canvas plugin to be enabled; directory listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; works on desktop and mobile, with the tools column hidden on phones.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's canvas gives you the surface. This gives you the pen, the nesting, and the way back
problem: Obsidian's Canvas has no freehand pen, no canvases inside canvases, and no way to see from a note which canvases it sits on.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's own Canvas plugin must be on.

summary: Ink drawing, nested canvases and per-note canvas backlinks for Obsidian's Canvas, with ink stored in the canvas file.
